It operates at 12V with a current of 5A and uses a 90W motor. The maximum pressure is 130PSI and the airflow is 17 litres per minute. The compressor can inflate an empty car tyre to 40PSI in under 7 minutes and can quickly top up a 195/70R14 tyre from 35 to 40PSI in less than 1 minute. It can run continuously for 20 minutes at 50PSI. The NOCO AL5 compressor can also be used as a power bank to charge phones, tablets, laptops and other electronics. Another feature is the integrated 50-lumen torch with adjustable brightness and emergency modes. Included in the package is a Presta valve adaptor, a needle, an inflatable toy adaptor, a quick-release coupling and a microfibre storage bag.
